title: Non-identity Paulis embed away from the identity
statement: Write $\{X, Y, Z\}$ for the three non-identity Pauli labels, embedded in the natural way into the full Pauli basis $\{I, X, Y, Z\}$. Then the image of every such label differs from the identity element $I$.
hypotheses_covered: a ranges over the three-element non-identity Pauli type
replaced:
For every $a \in \mathrm{PauliNZ}$, its image $a.\mathrm{toBasis}$ in the Pauli basis
differs from $I$; that is, the embedding of $\{X,Y,Z\}$ never hits the identity element.
